verdict.rationale: Bruno is a developer API client, so an official SDK is a fair thing for buyers to ask about and the axis applies. The pack documents only a CLI, Docker images for the CLI, and an in-app `bru` scripting API for pre- and post-request scripts. None of these is an official SDK that users can build against, and the CLI and scripting API are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
